test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Until recently, the village women ______ water from common wells or hand pumps, but now they have water taps.
solution:
The correct answer is '**fetched**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**fetched**'.
 
• It means 'to go to a place and bring back somebody/something'. (कहीं जाकर कुछ लाना)
 
 
• *Example: Shall I **fetch** you your coat?*
 
 
 
• In the given sentence the word '**fetch**' is referring to bringing water from common wells in the village.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Until recently, the village women __**fetched**__ water from common wells or hand pumps, but now they have water taps.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **sold**: to give something to somebody who pays for it and is then the owner of it. [किसी को कुछ बेचना (दाम लेकर वस्‍तु देना, और ग्राहक का वस्‍तु का स्‍वामी हो जाना)]
 
• **threw**: to send something from your hand through the air by moving your hand or arm quickly. [(किसी वस्‍तु को) फेंकना]
 
• **bought**: to get something by paying money for it. (ख़रीदना)
 
 

31:Tad0,

The correct answer is '**Indifferent**'.
